summary: Context-only committee read: the measured US backdrop has shifted to RISK_OFF, but this is not a fresh forecast or trade instruction. The most coherent deterioration is in trend, volatility, breadth, leadership, credit quality, and systematic positioning. The important counterweight is that recession risk remains off/low, liquidity quantity is expanding, volatility risk premium is rich, and the risk radar's exact caution-state 21-day pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Accordingly, the evidence supports heightened monitoring and thesis review, not origination or ranking.
what_fired: Persisted market-state transition from MIXED (46) to RISK_OFF (40), with trend -14 points and volatility -28 points session over session.
Breadth remains weak: 34.9% above 50-day averages, 49.4% above 200-day averages, and the breadth component is marked bad with divergence present.
Liquidity quality is stress-expansion despite an expanding quantity overlay; HY OAS has widened and NFCI trend is tightening.
Leadership is CRACKING; AI infrastructure leadership is broken, and systematic vol-control/CTA positioning is aligned cutting.
Factor intelligence did not fire: Pair G is dormant because the panel has only nine dates, below the 60-date requirement; factor attention remains A0/A1 shadow with n=0.
contradictions_review: The confluence graph reports a live briefing-divergence tension: 21 ticker-level demand-versus-supply oppositions, including NVDA, DHR, XOM, and GEHC. This is display-only and does not establish which side is correct. The options contradiction record is effectively null (n=0 and dated 2026-09-17), so it adds no current de-escalation evidence. The larger macro contradiction is quantity versus quality in liquidity: net liquidity is expanding, but its composition is labelled stress-expansion with confirming credit stress and an exhausted RRP buffer. The factor borrowed-strength ledger is absent by design until sufficient panel history accrues.
decaying_families: Alt-data is unarmed across regimes and horizons; pooled out-of-sample performance is negative.
Policy-family claims are unarmed and show negative signed excess across the available 5/21/63-day samples.
Desk narrative, radar, stock-desk, thematic-desk, and AI-desk 63-day estimates are negative and unarmed; several tests are explicitly vacuous rather than validated.
Demand-chain evidence is still accruing (9/12 effective events) and changes sign by horizon, so it is not reliable support.
CA/HK/CN board rows use unsigned MFE proxies and are unarmed because tests are vacuous or fail the preregistered edge bar; positive-looking values must not be read as directional validation.
Factor composite is non-tradeable; investment, low-vol, low-beta, and composite IC legs are negative, while the live panel has insufficient history.
deserves_operator: Review the RISK_OFF transition after the next completed-session update, focusing on whether trend/volatility deterioration persists while breadth remains weak.
Reconcile liquidity quantity with quality: expanding net liquidity is not presently equivalent to benign liquidity because stress confirmation and the exhausted RRP buffer remain active.
Score or retire every overdue Master Brain thesis; reconcile duplicate IDs and the simultaneously open opposing China-equity theses.
The China-equity overweight thesis conflicts with current China risk-off/panic context and contracting liquidity; evaluate its stated falsifier rather than carrying it open indefinitely.
The long-Treasury overweight theses conflict with restrictive/rising real yields and a bear-steepening backdrop; evaluate their explicit real-yield and curve falsifiers.

No current contradiction was found against the semiconductor-underweight theses; current broken AI leadership and semiconductor weakness are directionally consistent, but those theses are overdue and still require formal scoring.
Investigate the briefing-divergence set at its native ticker evidence layer before relying on the aggregate brief; the contradiction is a tension, not a replacement signal.
